description: This file defines a custom GLSurfaceView subclass (MyGLSurfaceView) used in an OpenGL ES Android application. It sets up the rendering context, manages touch events to manipulate the view's rotation angle, and interacts with a renderer class (MyGLRenderer).

classes.name: MyGLSurfaceView
classes.description: Custom GLSurfaceView subclass that manages OpenGL rendering context and user touch interactions for rotation control.

methods.name: MyGLSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GLSurfaceView with OpenGL ES 2.0 context, assigns the renderer, and sets render mode.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to adjust the rotation angle of the rendered object based on user interaction.
